queue.claim: Best-method claims: Pixel3DMM is more than 15% better on posed expressions, HRN led REALY at release (region-averaged frontal error about 1.5–1.6 mm against about 2 mm for DECA), and TEASER beats SMIRK on expression accuracy. The SMIRK, HRN, Pixel3DMM and TEASER licences are unknown.
